newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-SAINT-ANDRE AND BENETTON RETURN TO FACE ITALY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SAINT-ANDRE AND BENETTON RETURN TO FACE ITALY.

text.p: Winger Philippe Saint-Andre and flanker Philippe Benetton have been recalled to a reshuffled French rugby union squad to play Italy in Grenoble next Saturday.
Former captain Saint-Andre missed all four matches of France's successful Five Nations' campaign with a groin injury, while Benetton was absent from the last three games because of a broken jaw.
Skipper Abdel Benazzi, who led France to their 47-20 victory over Scotland on Saturday, felt he needed a rest and is not among a 21-strong squad containing a number of new faces.

Backs - Guy Accoceberry (Begles-Bordeaux), Gregory Sudre (Agen), David Aucagne (Pau), Nicolas Brusque (Pau), Benoit Bellot (Perpignan), Yann Delaigue (Toulon), Pierre Bondouy (Narbonne), Stephane Ougier (Toulouse), Philippe Saint-Andre (Montferrand), Jean-Luc Sadourny (Colomiers)

Forwards - Marc Dal Maso (Agen), Philippe Benetton (Agen), Raphael Ibanez (Dax), Marc de Rougemont (Toulon), Franck Tournaire (Narbonne), Jean-Louis Jordana (Toulouse), Hugues Miorin (Toulouse), Fabien Pelous (Dax), Olivier Merle (Montferrand), Arnaud Costes (Montferrand), Serge Betsen (Biarritz).
